subtype: Approach: family code word as a test [Action]
passage:
Papa had said it at breakfast: no word, no going.
"Yamini? Your father sent me to pick you up," the man said at the school gate.
Yamini stayed where she was. "What's the word?"
"The word?"
"Our family word. Only people Papa trusts know it."
"He didn't tell me any word. Come on, we'll be late."
"Then I'm not coming." She turned to the watchman. "Joseph Uncle, please call my father?"
"Fine, forget it," the man muttered, and walked off.
"Good girl," said Joseph Uncle. "Sit by my cabin. I'm calling him right now."

qa.q: Who does Yamini ask to call her father?
qa.a: She asks Joseph Uncle, the watchman.

qa.q: What was Yamini feeling when the man could not give the word?
qa.a: Wary and firm, since she refused to go and turned to the watchman for help.

qa.q: What else could Yamini's family add to keep pick-ups safe, and why?
qa.a: They could agree that Yamini phones her father to confirm any pick-up, which gives a second check besides the word.

qa.q: How does Joseph Uncle see Yamini's question about the word?
qa.a: Joseph Uncle sees a sensible child following a family plan, so he praises her and phones her father at once.

grounding: A family code word lets a girl test a man claiming her father sent him, and she leaves when he cannot give it.
